certificates.title: BRC PACKAGING CERTIFICATE
certificates.text: SinoPouch works to BRC-related food-safety management standards for packaging. Our partner factories maintain audited systems covering material control, production hygiene and traceability.

certificates.title: BSCI: BUSINESS SOCIAL COMPLIANCE INITIATIVE
certificates.text: We are committed to socially responsible manufacturing. Our production partners follow BSCI guidelines on labour standards, working conditions and ethical business practices.

oem_steps.title: 1 · Inquiry
oem_steps.text: Send your bag type, size, quantity and artwork (or a rough idea). We reply with questions and a quote within 24 hours.

oem_steps.title: 2 · Solution & Quotation
oem_steps.text: We recommend the material structure and printing method, then send a detailed FOB/CIF quote and timeline.

oem_steps.title: 3 · Artwork & Proof
oem_steps.text: Send your design (AI/PDF preferred). Our team lays out the dieline and sends a digital proof for approval.

oem_steps.title: 4 · Sampling
oem_steps.text: We produce physical samples — digital or gravure — and ship them to you for seal, print and fit checks.

oem_steps.title: 5 · Production
oem_steps.text: After sample approval and deposit, we run bulk production with in-line quality checks on print and sealing.

oem_steps.title: 6 · Delivery
oem_steps.text: Balance payment against B/L copy, then we ship to your port or door with full documentation support.
